import json,time,signal,hashlib,urllib.request,urllib.parse,urllib.error,sys
c=json.load(sys.stdin)
def alarm(s,f):raise TimeoutError()
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,alarm)
opener=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
value=dict(status='MODELSCOPE_SERVER_DIRECT_TWO_16MiB_SAMPLES',started_unix=time.time(),samples=[],credentials_used=False,model_files_written=0,original_workers_changed=False,GPU_submissions=0,ledger_written=False)
for trial in range(2):
 row=dict(trial=trial+1,requested_bytes=16<<20,range_start=c['range_start']);value['samples'].append(row);began=time.time();signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL,25)
 try:
  url='https://modelscope.cn/api/v1/models/unsloth/Cosmos-Reason1-7B/repo?'+urllib.parse.urlencode(dict(Revision='master',FilePath=c['path']))
  start=c['range_start'];count=16<<20
  request=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'Range':'bytes=%d-%d'%(start,start+count-1),'Accept-Encoding':'identity','User-Agent':'CARA-cache-bounded-identity-speed-test'})
  with opener.open(request,timeout=12) as response:
   row.update(http_status=response.status,final_host=urllib.parse.urlsplit(response.geturl()).hostname,content_range=response.headers.get('Content-Range'),header_seconds=time.time()-began)
   expected='bytes %d-%d/%d'%(start,start+count-1,c['size'])
   if response.status==206 and response.headers.get('Content-Range')==expected and response.headers.get('Content-Length')==str(count):
    data=response.read(count+1);row.update(received_bytes=len(data),sample_sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),first4MiB_sha256=hashlib.sha256(data[:4<<20]).hexdigest())
    row['status']='EXACT_RANGE_AND_SHARED_PREFIX_MATCH' if len(data)==count and row['first4MiB_sha256']==c['reference_first4MiB_sha256'] else 'SIZE_OR_SHARED_PREFIX_MISMATCH'
   else:row['status']='HTTP_OR_RANGE_REJECTED'
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:row.update(status='HTTP_ERROR',http_status=e.code)
 except Exception as e:row.update(status='PROBE_ERROR',error_type=type(e).__name__)
 finally:signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL,0);row['wall_seconds']=time.time()-began
 if row.get('status')=='EXACT_RANGE_AND_SHARED_PREFIX_MATCH':row['effective_MiB_per_second_including_headers']=16/row['wall_seconds']
value['ended_unix']=time.time();print(json.dumps(value))
